target: AArch64 native ZealC under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-timeclock-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-timeclock
checks: TimeClock launched from the graphical terminal and accepted punch-in/out descriptions.
The report command ran and saved descriptions were verified.
The app returned to the terminal; 40+2 evaluated correctly and zstatus reported failed=0.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-strut-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-strut
checks: Span opened its bridge instructions, drew a graphical frame, and recovered from Shift+Escape.
Strut opened its help, accepted edit/play input, drew two masses and a spring, and recovered from Escape.
Terminal recovery completed with zstatus failed=0.

scope_note: Automated QEMU evidence for these named app workflows on this exact ISO. This is not a visible UTM-window or Raspberry Pi interaction check; Span's save/reopen and Strut's complete physics remain outside this probe.
